definition: To ask urgently and earnestly for something.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: If there is any person in the town, who feels emotion caused by this man's death," said Scrooge quite agonised, "show that person to me, Spirit, I beseech you!"
example_sentence: I beseech you, please turn the music down.
